# Waleed Albadawi

> Building technology organisations that scale. Enterprise technology and transformation executive in regulated banking. VP, Enterprise Integration (Head of Integration) at a Saudi bank in Riyadh, with 14+ years in enterprise technology, most of them in Saudi banking and government. Recognized as a Tech100 Strategic Leader of the Future (Saudi Arabia Edition). Also known as Walid Albadawi, Waleed Al-Badawi.

Waleed Albadawi leads enterprise integration, platform strategy, regulatory connectivity and AI readiness in regulated banking. His work moves institutions from projects to platforms, from vendor dependency to owned capability, from reactive compliance to real-time regulatory connectivity, and from AI experiments to governed, AI-ready foundations. The function he leads, an organisation of 40+, gives the bank speed to market, control and ownership: new products and partners build on a shared, governed platform instead of bespoke integration; every change is automated, audited and reversible; and standards, pipelines and know-how are owned by the bank, not rented from vendors. In 2026 it delivered corporate internet banking, the IVR revamp, a digital partner app and national enforcement services.

Beyond integration, he shapes strategic technology reviews (core banking modernisation, treasury, corporate internet banking, payments, Open Banking), managed-services sourcing and governance, technology spend, and the resilience of critical services, and he founded the bank's Digital Factory.

## Signature programmes

- [Integration-as-a-Platform Strategy](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#integration-platform-strategy): integration repositioned from a cost centre to the bank's operating backbone across core, channel, payment, partner and regulatory systems.
- [Cloud-Native Banking Platform](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#cloud-native-banking-platform): containerised microservices and a zero-trust service mesh that the bank's digital estate runs on, including the SAIB Travel app, the retail, employee and corporate mobile apps and B2B corporate connectivity; critical services active-active across sites.
- [Automated Integration Delivery Platform](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#automated-integration-delivery): CI/CD and GitOps across the bank's integration platforms: every change automated, audited and reversible, with production deployment approval-gated by design.
- [Enterprise Integration Framework & Standards](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#integration-framework): a single framework of standards and review gates that every project and vendor builds to.
- [AI-Native Readiness & Engineering Governance](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#ai-native-readiness): governed foundations so AI can be adopted safely in a regulated bank; contributed to the secure-by-design review for AI enablement.
- [Regulatory Connectivity Programme](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#regulatory-connectivity): national enforcement, credit-bureau and central-bank reporting on one shared capability, so new mandates land on rails that already exist.
- [Open Banking, Built In-House](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#open-banking): the bank's own Open Banking platform (account information and payment initiation), built in-house to the FAPI 2.0 security profile.

## Topics

Enterprise integration strategy; integration platform modernisation; IBM Cloud Pak for Integration; API strategy and API economy; Open Banking (SAMA, FAPI 2.0); real-time payments (IPS, SARIE, SADAD); event-driven architecture; GitOps and platform engineering; integration governance and standards; AI readiness and AI governance in banking; regulatory technology; digital transformation in Saudi Arabia and Vision 2030.
